Post Reply Search Advanced search 2 posts • Page 1 of 1 Fulltone Mas Malo -->Fulltone Mas Malo Quote Share Post by SecretSam » Sun Jun 20, 2021 8:27 am Fulltone Mas Malo just arrived yesterday. It's the first Fulltone pedal I've had. Very impressed with the build and components. Nice stiff pots that stay where you put them. Good control layout. Best of all, it has loads and loads of highly useable sounds. Wherever the pots are set, plug it in and something comes out that sounds just right. You could probably replace a whole drawer full of drive and distortion pedals with two of these. Highly recommended.
